pages.title: Power Cuts Both Ways
pages.text: Balance a powerful weapon state against its actual health risk.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Wild Claws improves movement/attacks and control resistance but increases incoming damage. Blood Mania releases blood waves while draining health. Start safely; lethal risk is not required.
